notes:
The card duplicates the separate gh.simpler-env/maniskill2_real2sim package: its entry symbols are the same environment classes, but this card points at the simpler-env superproject, where the device code is a git submodule. Evidence: robots/simpler-env/simplerenv/.gitmodules:1-3 declares ManiSkill2_real2sim as a submodule, and the pinned superproject tree eddb5690749a1e34267807c0f7b5eede323918d7 contains it as gitlink 160000 at submodule commit ef7a4d4fdf4b69f2c2154db5b15b9ac8dfe10682, so the card's files ManiSkill2_real2sim/mani_skill2_real2sim/envs/custom_scenes/grasp_single_in_scene.py:470 and relatives do not exist in that tree. The superproject's own package is an evaluation wrapper, not an environment: robots/simpler-env/simplerenv/simpler_env/__init__.py:2 imports mani_skill2_real2sim.envs, and :74-87 make() maps a task name to gym.make(env_name); it defines no env class. The same classes and environment are already covered by the passing package MHS/drivers/robots/simpler-env__maniskill2_real2sim (task.json:4-7 and :27-30 name gh.simpler-env/maniskill2_real2sim with the same GraspSingle classes; RESULT.json records status pass). The gate run on this card failed G4.REF_MISSING for every fact because those refs are in the submodule, and G7.NATIVE_NOT_FOUND because the gate reads only the superproject's git object store; the card's own module prefix ManiSkill2_real2sim.mani_skill2_real2sim is also not the installed package path (the submodule installs mani_skill2_real2sim, setup.py:1-22 in the submodule checkout). No driver is proposed for this duplicate card; the draft files in this directory are not a passing package, no hardware was attached, and the hardware backend was never used.
